description: RecordsPage inline expand panel and RelationshipsPage table + expand row. Depends on FEAT-001 (CSS) and FEAT-002 (AppShell). RecordsPage is the most complex file (400 lines, adds ~200 lines of new state and InlineDetailPanel sub-component). RelationshipsPage converts individual .card elements to a results-table with an inline expansion row.
steps: Read src/records/RecordsPage.tsx in full before editing — the file is 400 lines and the row-click handler and table structure must be understood before modifying them.

Edit src/records/RecordsPage.tsx — state additions: add three new state variables after the existing state declarations: `const [expandedRecordId, setExpandedRecordId] = useState<string | null>(null)`, `const [panelData, setPanelData] = useState<Record<string, { record: LogRecord; history: RecordVersion[] }>>({})`, `const [panelLoading, setPanelLoading] = useState(false)`. Add import of RecordVersion from '../types'. Add import of SignatureModal from './SignatureModal'.

Edit src/records/RecordsPage.tsx — replace the existing onClick on table rows (currently `onClick={() => navigate(...)}`): remove the navigate call. Add handleRowClick function: if expandedRecordId === recordId, setExpandedRecordId(null) and return. Otherwise set expandedRecordId to recordId; if panelData[recordId] exists, return (cache hit). Call setPanelLoading(true), then Promise.all([recordsApi.get(logId!, recordId), recordsApi.history(logId!, recordId)]) .then(([rec, hist]) => setPanelData(prev => ({ ...prev, [recordId]: { record: rec, history: hist.versions } }))) .catch(() => setPanelData(prev => ({ ...prev, [recordId]: { record: null as unknown as LogRecord, history: [] } }))) .finally(() => setPanelLoading(false)). Add handlePanelMutated function: deletes panelData[recordId] key and calls loadRecords(page).

Edit src/records/RecordsPage.tsx — table structure: add a chevron column header (pc-col-chevron, no text) as the last . Ensure colSpan constant is displayColumns.length + 4 (Record# col + displayColumns + Status + Created + chevron = N+4). In each data row , change onClick from navigate to () => handleRowClick(record.id). Add cursor: pointer style to the tr. Add the chevron as the last cell showing ▾ when expandedRecordId === record.id, ▸ otherwise. After each data , insert the conditional detail row: `{expandedRecordId === record.id && ({panelLoading && !panelData[record.id] ?
Loading…
: panelData[record.id]?.record == null ?
Failed to load record detail.
: setExpandedRecordId(null)} onMutated={() => handlePanelMutated(record.id)} />})}`

Add InlineDetailPanel sub-component to src/records/RecordsPage.tsx (same file, after the main export). Interface: { log: LogDefinition; record: LogRecord; history: RecordVersion[]; logId: string; onClose: () => void; onMutated: () => void }. Internal state: panelTab ('lineage' | 'history', default 'lineage'), mode ('view' | 'edit' | 'correct', default 'view'), sigColumn (string | null), voidModal (boolean), voidReason (string), voidError (string). Render structure as specified in design §7: .detail-panel wrapper > .detail-panel-header (record-num span, RecordStatusBadge, close button) > when mode=view: .detail-panel-body grid (left: .detail-panel-fields with field-row/fl/fv for non-signature columns; right: signatures section with sig-row pattern + actions section with edit/correct/void buttons) > tab-bar/tab-btn section > PanelLineageView or PanelHistoryView. When mode=edit or correct: RecordEntryForm inside padding div. Void modal as fixed overlay with modal-card. Access signatures via (record as any).signatures — as any cast required since LogRecord has no signatures property. canEdit condition: same logic as RecordDetailPage (check record.status — only active/corrected records can be edited). RecordStatusBadge helper: renders a pc-badge with appropriate color variant based on record.status.

Add PanelLineageView sub-component to src/records/RecordsPage.tsx. Direct copy of the LineageView function from RecordDetailPage.tsx (takes { record: LogRecord } prop). Change: source block borderRadius: 8 → 0 (remove or set to 0). Change inner background '#f8fafc' → 'var(--brand-light)'.

Add PanelHistoryView sub-component to src/records/RecordsPage.tsx. Direct copy of the HistoryView function from RecordDetailPage.tsx (takes { history: RecordVersion[] } prop — note: RecordDetailPage's HistoryView takes { versions } but this can take { history } with internal rename). Change: version chip borderRadius: 4 → 2. Change: pre tag borderRadius: 8 → 0.
Read src/logs/RelationshipsPage.tsx in full before editing — it is 606 lines and contains a complex form.

Edit src/logs/RelationshipsPage.tsx. (a) Find `const lbl: React.CSSProperties` (line ~598) and delete it. (b) Replace all `style={lbl}` on label elements with `className="field-label"`. (c) Section headers inside RelationshipForm → `

`. (d) Replace the list of individual .card elements (one per relationship) with a single .results-table. Table columns: Name column with expand chevron (▾/▸), Source Log (flag-chip style={{ background: 'var(--brand-light)', color: 'var(--brand)' }}), Type (flag-chip), Target Log (flag-chip style={{ background: '#faf5ff', color: '#6d28d9' }}), Mappings count (numeric), Delete (danger icon button pc-btn pc-btn-danger pc-btn-sm). (e) Add expandedRelId: string | null state via useState(null). (f) After each relationship row tr, insert expansion row: when expandedRelId === rel.id, render showing field mappings as monospace text or small table. (g) The .form-panel for creating relationships stays in place — its square corners come from CSS. All relationship CRUD logic unchanged.

RecordsPage table rows call handleRowClick instead of navigate
RecordsPage renders InlineDetailPanel in an expansion row when a record is clicked
RecordsPage has InlineDetailPanel, PanelLineageView, PanelHistoryView sub-components defined in the same file
InlineDetailPanel renders detail-panel, detail-panel-header, detail-panel-body, tab-bar structure
InlineDetailPanel's edit and correct modes render RecordEntryForm inline; void triggers void modal
RelationshipsPage renders a results-table instead of individual .card elements
RelationshipsPage has expandedRelId state and renders field-mapping expansion rows
RelationshipsPage has no const lbl declaration; label elements use className="field-label"
